articles.abstract_en: Craig Gundersen is the Snee Family Endowed Chair at the Baylor Collaborative on Hunger and Poverty and a professor in the Department of Economics at Baylor University. Prior to joining Baylor, he was ACES Distinguished Professor in the Department of Agricultural and Consumer Economics at University of Illinois and, before that, he had positions at Iowa State University and USDA, Economic Research Service. Gundersen is currently also on the technical advisory group for Feeding America, the lead researcher on Feeding America's Map the Meal Gap project, a Round Table Fellow of the Farm Foundation, and a faculty affiliate of the Wilson Sheehan Lab for Economic Opportunities at the University of Notre Dame. From 2018 to 2022 he was the managing editor for Applied Economic Perspectives and Policy. For over 25 years, Gundersen's research has concentrated on the causes and consequences of food insecurity and on the evaluation of food assistance programs, with an emphasis on the Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program (SNAP, formerly known as the Food Stamp Program). In terms of the causes of food insecurity, his work has included, for example, examinations of the multigenerational households, American Indians, and food bank clients. Of particular note is his invention of Map the Meal Gap, which has become the standard tool to portray the geography of food insecurity in the U.S. He also has the two most cited review papers in this area with one of them recognized as the Outstanding Paper in the 2011 volume of AEPP. In terms of the consequences of food insecurity, his work has concentrated on dispelling myths of the connection between food insecurity and obesity, on the myriad negative health outcomes of food insecurity among seniors, and on the impacts of food insecurity on mortality and health care costs. He also has the most cited review paper on the consequences of food insecurity. With respect to his work evaluating food assistance programs, his work was the first to show that, after controlling for nonrandom selection into SNAP, recipients are less likely to be food insecure than eligible nonrecipients. This result was verified in further papers he co-authored including ones that also addressed misreporting of SNAP receipt. Gundersen's research has been published in top journals across a number of fields including in ag economics (e.g., AEPP, Food Policy, AJAE), economics (e.g., Journal of Human Resources, Journal of Econometrics, Journal of Health Economics), statistics (e.g., Journal of the American Statistical Association), nutrition (e.g., Journal of Nutrition), and medicine (e.g., New England Journal of Medicine, Canadian Medical Association Journal). His research has been funded by over $20 million in external funding from over 25 grants. These funds have come from several sources including the National Institute for Food and Agriculture (NIFA), Economic Research Service (ERS), Food and Nutrition Service (FNS), Foundation for Food and Agriculture Research (FFAR), and Canadian Institutes for Health Research (CIHR). The stature of his research and the importance of the topics he pursues has led Gundersen to frequently in the media and in presentations to policymakers and program administrators.
articles.abstract_cn: 克雷格·冈德森是贝勒大学饥饿与贫困合作组织的斯尼家族讲席教授，同时也是贝勒大学经济系的教授。在加入贝勒大学之前，他曾在伊利诺伊大学农业与消费经济系担任ACES杰出教授，更早之前，他在爱荷华州立大学和美国农业部经济研究局任职。冈德森目前还是美国消除饥饿组织技术咨询小组成员、该组织“绘制膳食缺口”项目的首席研究员、农场基金会圆桌会议研究员，以及圣母大学威尔逊·希恩经济机会实验室的教职附属人员。从2018年到2022年，他担任《应用经济展望与政策》杂志的主编。超过25年来，冈德森的研究集中于食物不安全的原因和后果，以及对食品援助项目的评估，重点关注补充营养援助计划（SNAP，前身为食品券计划）。在食物不安全的原因方面，他的工作包括例如对多代同堂家庭、美国印第安人和食物银行客户的研究。特别值得一提的是，他发明了“绘制膳食缺口”工具，该工具已成为描绘美国食物不安全地理分布的标准工具。他还拥有该领域被引用最多的两篇综述论文，其中一篇被评为《应用经济展望与政策》2011年卷的杰出论文。在食物不安全的后果方面，他的工作集中于破除食物不安全与肥胖之间关联的迷思、研究老年人食物不安全带来的众多负面健康结果，以及食物不安全对死亡率和医疗保健成本的影响。他还拥有关于食物不安全后果的被引用最多的综述论文。在评估食品援助项目的工作中，他的研究首次表明，在控制SNAP参与的非随机选择后，受助者比符合条件的非受助者更不可能面临食物不安全。这一结果在他合著的其他论文中得到了验证，包括那些也处理SNAP领取误报问题的论文。冈德森的研究发表在多个领域的顶级期刊上，包括农业经济学（如《应用经济展望与政策》、《食品政策》、《美国农业经济学杂志》）、经济学（如《人力资源杂志》、《计量经济学杂志》、《健康经济学杂志》）、统计学（如《美国统计协会杂志》）、营养学（如《营养杂志》）和医学（如《新英格兰医学杂志》、《加拿大医学会杂志》）。他的研究获得了超过20万美元的外部资助，来自超过25项拨款。这些资金来自多个来源，包括国家食品与农业研究所（NIFA）、经济研究局（ERS）、食品与营养服务局（FNS）、食品与农业研究基金会（FFAR）和加拿大健康研究所（CIHR）。他的研究地位和他所研究主题的重要性，使得冈德森经常出现在媒体上，并向政策制定者和项目管理者做报告。

articles.title_en: A call for justice work in agricultural and applied economics
articles.title_cn: 呼吁农业与应用经济学中的正义工作
articles.abstract_en: This presidential address calls the membership to explore ways of doing justice work in their research, teaching, extension, and outreach activities. By sharing my story and developing a content analysis of presidential addresses and invited papers published in the Agricultural and Applied Economics Association journals, I demonstrate how race has shaped my work and the need for additional work in this area. Through this example, I hope that members of the profession will find new inspiration to do justice work.
articles.abstract_cn: 这篇主席致辞呼吁成员们在研究、教学、推广和外联活动中探索开展正义工作的方式。通过分享我的个人经历，并对农业与应用经济学协会期刊上发表的主席致辞和特邀论文进行内容分析，我展示了种族如何塑造了我的工作，以及在该领域开展更多工作的必要性。通过这个例子，我希望本专业的成员能找到新的灵感来开展正义工作。

articles.title_en: Outsourcing the dry season: Cattle ranchers' responses to weather shocks in the Brazilian Amazon
articles.title_cn: 外包旱季：巴西亚马逊地区养牛户对天气冲击的应对
articles.abstract_en: Livestock production plays a vital role in the global economy, yet little is known about how climate change will affect the industry. Studies of crop agriculture may not translate to livestock agriculture due to differences in the set of potential adaptation strategies. Ranchers' responses to changing weather and climate are particularly relevant in the Brazilian Amazon, where the dry season is increasing by as much as 0.6 days per year. A longer dry season increases production risks as animals may succumb to starvation, lack of water, or heat stress. I pair transaction data and weather shocks to show that ranchers strategically sold animals prior to the dry season, in response to two predictors of an extreme dry season: sporadic rainfall and high temperatures prior to the dry season. Ranchers sold animals for both fattening and slaughter in response to sporadic rainfall prior. Nearly half of animals initially sold for fattening were sold for slaughter 90 days later. In contrast, ranchers responded to high temperatures solely by selling for slaughter, suggesting that current on‐farm technologies are insufficient to prevent losses from heat stress. The overall supply increased in years with sporadic rainfall and high temperatures, but the supply fell by a greater amount the following year. My results suggest that farmers are currently not fully insulated from the effects of a severe dry season. As severe dry seasons become more frequent, the industry will likely increasingly rely on feedlots and need additional methods to cope with heat stress.
articles.abstract_cn: 畜牧业在全球经济中扮演着重要角色，但关于气候变化将如何影响该行业的研究却很少。由于潜在的适应策略组合不同，针对农作物农业的研究可能无法直接适用于畜牧业。在巴西亚马逊地区，养牛户对天气和气候变化的应对尤为相关，因为该地区的旱季每年增加多达0.6天。更长的旱季会增加生产风险，因为动物可能因饥饿、缺水或热应激而死亡。我将交易数据与天气冲击相结合，表明养牛户在旱季之前战略性出售动物，以应对极端旱季的两个预测指标：旱季前的零星降雨和高温。养牛户针对之前的零星降雨出售用于育肥和屠宰的动物。最初出售用于育肥的动物中，近一半在90天后被出售用于屠宰。相比之下，养牛户仅通过出售用于屠宰来应对高温，这表明当前的农场技术不足以防止热应激造成的损失。在零星降雨和高温的年份，总供应量增加，但次年供应量下降幅度更大。我的结果表明，农民目前并未完全免受严重旱季的影响。随着严重旱季变得更加频繁，该行业可能将越来越依赖育肥场，并需要额外的方法来应对热应激。

articles.title_en: Sectoral wage gaps and gender in rural India †
articles.title_cn: 印度农村的部门工资差距与性别
articles.abstract_en: Using detailed monthly household panel data from rural India, I analyze sectoral wage gaps for men and women. I show that the wage gap across the non‐farm and farm sectors is much higher for women than for men. Relative to men, women also work less time in non‐farm wage employment than in farm wage employment. Taken together, these findings suggest that constraints are preventing women from reallocating their time to more remunerative wage employment opportunities. Women are less likely to work outside of their own village in the non‐farm sector, yet the wage gap is driven by higher caste and married women. These results are consistent with a lack of local non‐farm employment opportunities interacting with barriers to labor mobility for women but not men.
articles.abstract_cn: 利用印度农村详细的月度家庭面板数据，我分析了男性和女性的部门工资差距。我表明，非农部门与农业部门之间的工资差距，女性远高于男性。相对于男性，女性在非农工资就业上的时间也少于农业工资就业。综合来看，这些发现表明存在制约因素，阻碍女性将时间重新分配到报酬更高的工资就业机会上。女性在非农部门中更不可能在本村以外工作，然而工资差距却由高种姓和已婚女性驱动。这些结果与当地非农就业机会缺乏以及女性（而非男性）劳动力流动障碍相互作用的情况一致。

articles.title_cn: 关于出口持续期的谜题
articles.abstract_en: We investigate two puzzles in the export duration literature. The first puzzle has to do with the frequent entries and exits of firms in export markets, which are at odds with the large fixed export costs in such markets. We introduce convex production technologies in a trade model to show how variable marginal costs create direct linkages between export markets. As fixed export costs vary across destinations, more productive firms need not necessarily export to more destinations. Cost convexity implies that the probability of supplying a given export market is adversely affected by positive export shocks in other markets. This is supported by our empirical analysis of bilateral flows for over 200 agri‐food products to 176 destinations originating from six large exporting countries. The second puzzle has to do with the paradoxical effect of tariffs reported in empirical export duration studies. When endogeneity is addressed, tariffs increase the probability of an export failure.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究了出口持续期文献中的两个谜题。第一个谜题与企业在出口市场中频繁进入和退出有关，这与该市场中巨大的固定出口成本相矛盾。我们在贸易模型中引入凸性生产技术，以展示可变边际成本如何在出口市场之间建立直接联系。由于固定出口成本因目的地而异，生产率更高的企业不一定出口到更多目的地。成本凸性意味着，供应某一出口市场的概率会受到其他市场正向出口冲击的不利影响。我们对来自六个主要出口国、涵盖超过200种农产品和食品、出口至176个目的地的双边流量进行的实证分析支持了这一观点。第二个谜题涉及实证出口持续期研究中报告的关税悖论效应。当处理内生性后，关税增加了出口失败的概率。

articles.title_en: Unemployment benefits, food insecurity, and supplemental nutrition assistance program spending
articles.title_cn: 失业救济、粮食不安全和补充营养援助计划支出
articles.abstract_en: This paper examines the effects of unemployment insurance (UI) expansions on household food insecurity in the United States using the Food Security Supplement to the Current Population Survey for 1999–2017. We exploit the plausibly exogenous variation in state maximum weekly UI benefits across states and over time. The two‐part model demonstrates that a $100 increase in state weekly UI benefits reduces the likelihood of food insecurity among UI‐eligible families by 5.6% and the severity of food insecurity conditional on being food insecure by 6.3%. We further present strong evidence of program substitution between UI and the Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program (SNAP), which is the largest food assistance program with the stated goal of reducing food insecurity. Specifically, for every dollar spent on UI, 4–11 cents can be saved on SNAP, thereby reinforcing the social benefits of an UI expansion .
articles.abstract_cn: 本文利用1999-2017当前人口调查的粮食安全补充资料，探讨了失业保险（UI）扩大对美国家庭粮食不安全的影响。我们利用各州和不同时间段内各州最大每周失业保险福利的看似合理的外生变化。两部分模型表明，州每周失业保险福利增加100美元，可使符合失业保险资格的家庭出现粮食不安全的可能性降低5.6%，并将以粮食不安全为条件的粮食不安全的严重程度降低6.3%。我们进一步提供了 UI 和补充营养援助计划 (SNAP) 之间计划替代的有力证据，该计划是最大的粮食援助计划，其既定目标是减少粮食不安全。具体来说，每在失业保险上花费一美元，就可以在 SNAP 上节省 4-11 美分，从而增强失业保险扩展的社会效益。

articles.title_en: Assessing the affordability of nutrient‐adequate diets
articles.title_cn: 评估营养充足饮食的可负担性
articles.abstract_en: The cost and affordability of least‐cost healthy diets by time and place are increasingly used as a proxy for access to nutrient‐adequate diets. Recent work has focused on the nutrient requirements of individuals, although most food and antipoverty programs target whole households. This raises the question of how the cost of a nutrient‐adequate diet can be measured for an entire household. This study identifies upper and lower bounds on the feasibility, cost, and affordability of meeting all household members' nutrient requirements using 2013–2017 survey data from Malawi. Findings show only a minority of households can afford the nutrient‐adequate diet at either bound, with 20% of households able to afford the (upper bound) shared diets and 38% the individualized (lower bound) diets. Individualized diets are more frequently feasible with locally available foods (90% vs. 60% of the time) and exhibit more moderate seasonal fluctuation. To meet all members' needs, a shared diet requires a more nutrient‐dense combination of foods that is more costly and exhibits more seasonality in diet cost than any one food group or the individualized diets. The findings further help adjudicate the extent to which nutritional behavioral change programs versus broader agricultural and food policies can be relied upon to improve individual access to healthy diets.
articles.abstract_cn: 按时间和地点计算的最低成本健康饮食的成本和可负担性，越来越被用作获取营养充足饮食的代理指标。近期研究聚焦于个体的营养需求，尽管大多数食品和反贫困项目针对的是整个家庭。这提出了一个问题：如何衡量整个家庭的营养充足饮食成本。本研究利用马拉维2013-2017年的调查数据，确定了满足所有家庭成员营养需求的可行性、成本和可负担性的上下界。研究发现，只有少数家庭能够负担得起任一界限下的营养充足饮食，其中20%的家庭能够负担得起（上界）共享饮食，38%的家庭能够负担得起个体化（下界）饮食。个体化饮食在本地可得食品中更常可行（90%对60%的时间），并且表现出更温和的季节性波动。为满足所有成员的需求，共享饮食需要更营养密集的食物组合，其成本更高，且饮食成本的季节性比任何单一食物组或个体化饮食都更明显。这些发现进一步有助于评判营养行为改变项目与更广泛的农业和食品政策在多大程度上可被依赖以改善个体获取健康饮食的机会。

articles.title_en: Was the trip worth it? Consistency between decision and experienced utility assessments of recreational nature visits
articles.title_cn: 这次旅行值得吗？休闲自然访问的决策效用与体验效用评估之间的一致性
articles.abstract_en: This paper assesses the relationship between decision utility and experienced utility of recreational nature visits. The former is measured as the travel cost to reach that site as routinely used by the travel cost method (TCM), and the latter is operationalized through visit‐related subjective well‐being (SWB). As such, the analysis is a test of convergent validity by examining whether ex ante TCM‐based assessment of recreational value reflecting decision utility corresponds to stated ex post SWB, reflecting experienced utility. It explores to what extent utility revealed by counts of nature visits are associated with self‐reported, visit‐related SWB relating to that same visited site. The analysis uses two existing datasets providing information on (i) 3672 recreational visits to green/blue spaces in England over the course of four years and (ii) 5937 recreational visits to bluespace sites across 14 European countries over one year. Results show a positive association between travel cost and visit‐related SWB while controlling for trip frequency and a large set of covariates, suggesting convergent validity of the two utility concepts. A breakdown by travel mode suggests this relationship only holds for trips involving motorized transport and is not present for habitual, chore‐like walking visits to the recreational site.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文评估了休闲自然访问的决策效用与体验效用之间的关系。前者通过旅行成本法（TCM）常规使用的到达该地点的旅行成本来衡量，后者则通过访问相关的主观幸福感（SWB）来操作化。因此，该分析是对收敛效度的检验，通过考察基于TCM的事前休闲价值评估（反映决策效用）是否与陈述的事后SWB（反映体验效用）相对应。它探讨了由自然访问次数揭示的效用在多大程度上与自我报告的、与访问地点相关的SWB相关联。分析使用了两个现有数据集，分别提供（i）英格兰四年间3672次对绿色/蓝色空间的休闲访问信息，以及（ii）14个欧洲国家一年内5937次对蓝色空间地点的休闲访问信息。结果表明，在控制访问频率和大量协变量的情况下，旅行成本与访问相关SWB之间存在正相关关系，表明这两种效用概念具有收敛效度。按出行方式细分表明，这种关系仅适用于涉及机动化交通的出行，而对于习惯性的、像家务活一样的步行访问休闲地点的情况则不存在。

articles.title_en: Incorporating historical weather information in crop insurance rating
articles.title_cn: 在农作物保险定价中纳入历史天气信息
articles.abstract_en: Crop insurance programs rely on conditional predictive distributions of loss random variables (e.g., yield, revenue, loss costs, etc.) to determine probabilities and magnitudes of loss. The loss variables may be related to stochastic variables that are not known at the time the policy is priced. Such is the case for weather; weather is stochastic, realizations are not known when the crop insurance policy is sold, and there is often additional historical information on weather relative to the loss variable itself. We provide a Bayesian methodology for incorporating historical weather information in crop insurance rating. We apply the method in empirical applications to county‐level U.S. corn yields and loss cost ratios in the Midwest. The historical weather‐conditioned distributions differ from those based on shorter samples. In the yield distribution setting, additional temporal weather information leads to economic gains relative to other rating approaches; the magnitude of these gains increases with the amount of historical weather information included in the analysis.
articles.abstract_cn: 农作物保险计划依赖于损失随机变量（如产量、收入、损失成本等）的条件预测分布来确定损失的概率和幅度。损失变量可能与保单定价时未知的随机变量相关。天气就是这种情况；天气是随机的，农作物保险单出售时实现值未知，而且相对于损失变量本身，通常有额外的历史天气信息。我们提供了一种贝叶斯方法，用于在农作物保险定价中纳入历史天气信息。我们在美国中西部县级玉米产量和损失成本比率的实证应用中应用了该方法。基于历史天气条件的分布与基于较短样本的分布不同。在产量分布设定中，额外的时序天气信息相对于其他定价方法带来了经济收益；这些收益的幅度随着分析中包含的历史天气信息量的增加而增加。

articles.title_en: The impacts of tropical storms on food prices: Evidence from China
articles.title_cn: 热带风暴对食品价格的影响：来自中国的证据
articles.abstract_en: Climate change is a major source of external shocks to the economy. In this article, we estimate the short‐term impacts of tropical storms on food prices. After matching the track records of tropical storms with retail prices of food products during 1998 and 2012 in China, we find that tropical storms lead to food prices increasing by 2.3%, and the effect lasts more than one month. The positive impacts on prices mainly concentrate on fresh vegetable products. One main channel of price increases caused by tropical storms is the supply‐side shock to the transportation and distribution system. We find limited evidence of price increases driven by demand‐side shocks such as food displacement and food composition changes. The impacts of tropical storms on food price increases lead to a total loss amounting to $92 million each year on average. This study contributes to literature evaluating the price impacts caused by tropical storms and provides policy implications on enhancing food supply resilience.
articles.abstract_cn: 气候变化是经济外部冲击的主要来源。在本文中，我们估计了热带风暴对食品价格的短期影响。将1998年至2012年间中国的热带风暴路径记录与食品零售价格匹配后，我们发现热带风暴导致食品价格上涨2.3%，且该效应持续超过一个月。价格的正向影响主要集中在新鲜蔬菜产品上。热带风暴导致价格上涨的一个主要渠道是运输和分销系统的供给侧冲击。我们发现的证据有限，表明需求侧冲击（如食品转移和食品构成变化）驱动价格上涨。热带风暴对食品价格上涨的影响导致年均总损失达92万美元。本研究为评估热带风暴引起的价格影响的文献做出了贡献，并为增强食品供应韧性提供了政策启示。

articles.title_en: Economic impacts of food safety incidents in a modern supply chain: E. coli in the romaine lettuce industry
articles.title_cn: 现代供应链中食品安全事件的经济影响：长叶生菜行业中的大肠杆菌事件
articles.abstract_en: Food‐safety incidents disrupt impacted markets, cause destruction of edible product, shake consumer confidence, and impose economic losses upon participants across the implicated supply chain. Despite the prevalence of such incidents, we know surprisingly little about their supply chain impacts, especially in modern produce markets where contracts may impede the diffusion of price impacts through the supply chain. The November 2018 E. coli incident for romaine lettuce in Central California roiled North American produce markets throughout the fall of 2018 and well into 2019. Our study of the economic impacts of this incident benefited from access to disaggregate information on prices and sales for romaine and substitute leafy greens at all stages of the supply chain, enabling us to overcome data limitations that have impeded prior studies. We decompose impacts from the incident into price and quantity components. Romaine growers were largely protected from damage due to fixed‐price provisions in grower‐processor contracts. Economic losses were incurred mostly by romaine shippers and processors, and grocery retailers who pulled saleable product from the supply chain and lost sales during and well after the incident due to reduced consumer demand. We estimate that the total societal loss from the incident was in the range of $276–$343 million. Widespread and long‐lasting impacts from a food‐safety incident demonstrate the economic benefit of industries adopting mandatory food‐safety standards and improved traceability to minimize the occurrence and impacts of such incidents.
articles.abstract_cn: 食品安全事件扰乱受影响市场，导致可食用产品被销毁，动摇消费者信心，并给相关供应链上的参与者带来经济损失。尽管此类事件频发，但我们对它们在供应链中的影响知之甚少，尤其是在现代农产品市场中，合同可能阻碍价格影响在供应链中的传导。2018年十一月发生在加利福尼亚中部长叶生菜上的大肠杆菌事件，在2018年秋季乃至2019年全年扰乱了北美农产品市场。我们对该事件经济影响的研究得益于获取了供应链各阶段长叶生菜及替代叶菜的价格和销售的细分信息，从而克服了以往研究受数据限制的障碍。我们将事件的影响分解为价格和数量两部分。由于种植者与加工商合同中固定价格条款的规定，长叶生菜种植者基本免受损害。经济损失主要由长叶生菜托运商和加工商承担，以及那些在事件期间及之后因消费者需求减少而将可销售产品撤出供应链并遭受销售损失的杂货零售商。我们估计，该事件造成的总社会损失在276亿至343亿美元之间。食品安全事件广泛而持久的影响表明，行业采用强制性食品安全标准和改进可追溯性以尽量减少此类事件的发生和影响，具有经济上的益处。

articles.title_en: The Achilles heel of the U.S. food industries: Exposure to labor and upstream industries in the supply chain
articles.title_cn: 美国食品工业的致命弱点：供应链中劳动力和上游行业的暴露度
articles.abstract_en: The modern‐day food industries are part of a complex agri‐food supply chain, where food production has become efficient yet potentially vulnerable to supply chain risks. The COVID‐19 pandemic is a testament to that end. This article measures and identifies the U.S. food manufacturing industries' vulnerability to upstream industries and labor occupations by ( a ) calculating a food industry's diversification of intermediate input purchases across upstream industries, ( b ) quantifying the relative exposure of food manufacturing in a given industry and location to upstream input suppliers and labor occupations, and ( c ) estimating each food industry's gross output elasticity of inputs. This article also explores geographic heterogeneity in food industries' vulnerability. Among our results, we find evidence that the animal processing industry's output is relatively vulnerable to production labor, consistent with the observed disruptions to the meatpacking sector during COVID‐19, which were largely caused by labor issues. Our results may help academics and practitioners to understand food industries' vulnerabilities to upstream industries and labor occupations.
articles.abstract_cn: 现代食品工业是复杂农业食品供应链的一部分，食品生产已变得高效，但可能面临供应链风险。COVID-19疫情便是明证。本文通过以下方式衡量和识别美国食品制造业对上游行业和劳动力职业的脆弱性：（a）计算食品行业在上游行业中的中间投入品购买多样化程度，（b）量化特定行业和地点的食品制造业对上游投入供应商和劳动力职业的相对暴露度，以及（c）估算每个食品行业的总产出投入弹性。本文还探讨了食品行业脆弱性的地理异质性。在我们的结果中，我们发现动物加工业的产出相对容易受到生产劳动力的影响，这与COVID-19疫情期间肉类加工部门观察到的中断一致，这些中断主要由劳动力问题引起。我们的结果可能有助于学者和从业者理解食品行业对上游行业和劳动力职业的脆弱性。

articles.title_en: Farm labor supply and fruit and vegetable production
articles.title_cn: 农业劳动力供给与果蔬生产
articles.abstract_en: This study provides econometric estimates of the effects of reductions in farm labor supply on the production of hand‐harvested fruits and vegetables. Using crop production and employment data from California counties, we estimate panel regressions linking farm employment to crop production outcomes. Because we exploit variation in equilibrium employment, as opposed to exogenous variation in the labor supply curve, we use an equilibrium displacement model to identify the most likely sources of estimation bias and conclude that our regression estimates should be interpreted as upper bounds for the effect of interest. Our results indicate that a 10% decrease in the farm labor supply (in terms of the number of workers) causes at most a 4.2% reduction in production in the top 10 fruit and vegetable producing counties. Production effects are channeled primarily through a reduction in harvested acreage, although we also uncover some effects on yield.
articles.abstract_cn: 本研究提供了关于农业劳动力供给减少对手工采摘果蔬生产影响的计量经济学估计。利用加利福尼亚各县的作物生产和就业数据，我们估计了将农业就业与作物生产结果联系起来的面板回归。由于我们利用的是均衡就业的变化，而非劳动力供给曲线的外生变化，我们使用均衡位移模型来识别最可能的估计偏差来源，并得出结论，我们的回归估计应被解释为所关注效应的上界。我们的结果表明，农业劳动力供给（以工人数量计）减少10%最多导致前10个果蔬生产县的生产减少4.2%。生产效应主要通过收获面积的减少来传导，尽管我们也发现了一些对单产的影响。

articles.title_en: Trade uncorked: Genetic distance and taste‐related barriers in wine trade
articles.title_cn: 贸易开瓶：基因距离与葡萄酒贸易中的口味相关壁垒
articles.abstract_en: A nascent literature explores the impact of taste differences on trade. In gravity model estimations, the coefficient on geographic distance is large because it tends to capture such (usually unobservable) preference‐related frictions. We examine this question in the context of French wine, that is, a cultural good characterized by a great variety of types (i.e. accommodating a large heterogeneity in wine tastes) and of quality levels (from cheap table wine to the finest grands crus ). A series of gravity models are estimated using the universe of French bottled wine exports by detailed appellation between 1998 and 2015. We use genetic distance as a proxy for taste differences inherited from biology and culture. We show that this interpretation is not ruled out by other possible roles of genetic distance on trade (i.e., microgeography or non‐gustatory cultural dimensions such as trust). We find that genetic distance has an independent effect on trade, explaining between 20% and 40% of the coefficient on geographic distance. Dynamic estimates confirm this result and establish both the persistent and contemporaneous effects of genetic differences. A heterogeneous analysis also corroborates previous findings in the literature showing that high‐tier goods tend to escape gravity. In addition, we find that premium wines escape the home bias associated with taste differences, possibly illustrating that luxury wines have become global iconic products purchased for status and investment motives rather than for gustatory pleasure.
articles.abstract_cn: 一个新兴的文献探讨了口味差异对贸易的影响。在引力模型估计中，地理距离的系数很大，因为它往往捕捉了这类（通常不可观测的）与偏好相关的摩擦。我们在法国葡萄酒的背景下研究这个问题，即一种以类型多样（即容纳葡萄酒口味的巨大异质性）和质量等级（从廉价餐酒到最顶级的特级园）为特征的文化产品。我们使用1998年至2015年间法国瓶装葡萄酒按详细产区划分的全部出口数据，估计了一系列引力模型。我们使用基因距离作为从生物学和文化中继承的口味差异的代理变量。我们表明，这种解释并未被基因距离对贸易的其他可能作用（即微观地理或非味觉的文化维度，如信任）所排除。我们发现基因距离对贸易有独立影响，解释了地理距离系数的20%至40%。动态估计证实了这一结果，并确立了基因差异的持续性和同期效应。异质性分析也证实了文献中的先前发现，表明高端商品往往逃脱引力效应。此外，我们发现优质葡萄酒逃脱了与口味差异相关的本土偏好，这可能说明奢侈葡萄酒已成为全球标志性产品，购买动机是地位和投资，而非味觉享受。

articles.title_en: Housing booms and H‐2A agricultural guest worker employment
articles.title_cn: 住房繁荣与H-2A农业客工就业
articles.abstract_en: This paper examines the effects of changes in housing demand on H‐2A employment within commuting zones from 2001 to 2017. Agricultural employers who demonstrate that no workers in the domestic labor market are willing or able to perform a seasonal or temporary farm job can apply for certification to hire guest workers through the H‐2A visa program. H‐2A employment grew more than 450% between 2001 and 2019 from 45,000 to 258,000. This is one of the first papers to econometrically examine causal factors that contributed to the growth of H‐2A employment. We find that a 1% increase in housing demand leads to a 0.40%–0.97% increase in H‐2A employment. We also show suggestive evidence that changes in housing demand affect H‐2A employment through shifts in the demand for workers in nonfarm industries that pull workers from the agricultural sector. Consistent with previous literature, we show that positive housing demand shocks lead to increased employment in construction and other nontradable sectors that traditionally hire immigrant workers. We also find positive effects of housing demand on local farm wages, consistent with an inward shift in the local farm labor supply during housing booms.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文考察了2001年至2017年间通勤区内住房需求变化对H-2A就业的影响。农业雇主若能证明国内劳动力市场上没有工人愿意或能够从事季节性临时农业工作，即可申请通过H-2A签证计划认证雇佣客工。H-2A就业在2001年至2019年间增长了超过450%，从45,000人增至258,000人。本文是首批运用计量经济学方法研究H-2A就业增长因果因素的论文之一。我们发现住房需求每增加1%，H-2A就业增加0.40%至0.97%。我们还提供了提示性证据，表明住房需求变化通过非农行业对工人的需求变化影响H-2A就业，这些非农行业从农业部门吸引工人。与以往文献一致，我们表明正向住房需求冲击导致建筑业和其他传统上雇佣移民工人的非贸易部门就业增加。我们还发现住房需求对当地农业工资有正向影响，这与住房繁荣期间当地农业劳动力供给向内转移一致。
